RIGHT hand has one red talisman fan, LEFT hand has one brass bell. Follow gentle arm/clothing movement from A to B. Keep left-hand bell in near hand and right-hand cards correctly. Two boots only; no support swap, no jump. Blank6% top and bottom margin in each quadrant and clear middle gap.
